I also love languages! Unfortunately it takes a lot of time and ambition to improve, plus you forget stuff pretty fast if you don't keep on practicing. I myself speak german (first language), english and have learned french at school but I still have a hard time learning it and was never able to speak it fluently.

For anyone who is learning a language I can only suggest:

Try out a certain app, not sure if I'm allowed to name it, but it is an app where you can find chatpartners that are trying to learn your language and speak the language you want to learn. The app features a translation tool (although not always correct but both can see i,t so if it is incorrect the other one can tell you), a correction tool, saves all your corrections so you can look them up later, and much more.
